sources.title: Qwen3-4B MLX 8-bit | Private Self-Hosted LLM for Ops AI
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-MLX-8bit is an 8-bit quantized version of Qwen's 4B instruction model, packaged for MLX (Apple's ML framework). It trades some precision for ~4-6 GB memory footprint, making it deployable on Mac hardware without external infrastructure.
